name: Gorgias
description: Chosen by Lysias with Ptolemee the son of Dorymenes and Nicanor to go into the land of Juda; led a night raid against Judas's camp at Emmaus that failed, and later as a captain fought and discomfited Joseph the son of Zacharias and Azarias at Jamnia

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
